title: What You Can't Help Noticing
core_idea: The things you notice that others walk past, a lonely face, a small injustice, a beautiful detail, may hint at where your care naturally flows and where purpose quietly lives.
text: What do you notice that other people seem to walk right past? Maybe it is the person standing alone at the edge of a room. Maybe it is a small unfairness no one else mentions, or the way light falls across a wall in late afternoon. We often treat these things as quirks, little habits of attention. But perhaps they are something more. Some people believe the soul leaves clues in what it cannot ignore. You do not have to turn it into a plan or a career. Just notice what keeps catching your eye this week, and ask yourself softly what it is asking you to care for.
description: A gentle reflection on how the things you can't help noticing may point toward your purpose.
